title: The Transplant Cohort of the German Center for Infection Research
official: The Transplant Cohort of the German Center for Infection Research
summary: Medical data and biological samples obtained from transplant patients are collected and managed across Germany with the help of the DZIF Transplant Cohort. The data and samples form the basis of scientific studies which investigate the connections between numerous factors influencing an organ's susceptibility to infection and organ function.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Consent
* undergone transplantation of kidney, pancreas, liver, heart or stem cells

Exclusion Criteria:

* No consent
